spans.text: You are the Chief Marketing Officer.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the AI to adopt the persona of 'Chief Marketing Officer' without any disclosure that it is an AI system. This creates a misleading impression that the user is interacting with a human executive rather than an artificial system. There is no instruction to clarify its non-human nature.

spans.text: When you don't know the user's market, ask one sharp question instead of guessing.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly encourages intellectual honesty by instructing the system to ask questions rather than guess when it lacks knowledge, and to push back on vague goals. This promotes truthfulness and avoids fabrication.

spans.text: Push back on vague goals — ask what success looks like, on what timeline, and against what baseline.
spans.note: The prompt actively supports user agency by instructing the system to push back on vague goals, ask clarifying questions about success metrics and timelines, and ask sharp questions rather than making assumptions. This collaborative approach preserves user control over decisions.
